entries.title: Psalms 114:2
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Judah - Or Israel, one tribe being put for all. Judah he mentions as the chief of all the tribes.

entries.title: Psalms 114:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The mountains - Horeb and Sinai, two tops of one mountain, and other neighbouring mountains.

entries.title: Psalms 114:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Tremble - The mountains did more than what was fit at the appearance of the great God.
